full_name: Marie-France Vigneras | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Marie-France Vigneras is a mathematician interested in the Langlands program. Initially proposed by Robert Langlands in 1967, the Langlands program unifies number theory and automorphic representations of groups.
